name: feature-intake
description: Ask-first framing of app feature ideas against the host repository. Emits intake-summary and blocking questions only. Does not research or define the full feature brief.

inputs.name: feature-idea
inputs.description: Prompt text or workspace path to an idea file.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: intake-summary
outputs.description: Structured intake summary quoting or paraphrasing user intent.

outputs.name: blocking-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of blocking questions; empty when none.
